name: magic-card
title: Magic Card
description: A spotlight effect that follows your mouse cursor and highlights borders on hover.

props.name: mode
props.description: `gradient`: a spotlight follows the pointer. `orb`: a blurred gradient orb follows it.

props.name: gradientSize
props.description: Radius of the spotlight and border glow in pixels.

props.name: gradientColor
props.description: Spotlight colour (gradient mode). CSS variables work, e.g. for light/dark values.

props.name: gradientFrom
props.description: Start colour of the border glow.

props.name: gradientTo
props.description: End colour of the border glow.

props.name: glowFrom
props.description: Start colour of the orb (orb mode).

props.name: glowTo
props.description: End colour of the orb (orb mode).

props.name: glowAngle
props.description: Angle of the orb gradient in degrees (orb mode).

props.name: glowSize
props.description: Diameter of the orb in pixels (orb mode).

props.name: glowBlur
props.description: Blur of the orb in pixels (orb mode).

props.name: glowOpacity
props.description: Opacity of the orb while hovered (orb mode).
